description: As an analyst I can include Sysmon events in the timeline and process view so I get richer process telemetry when Sysmon is deployed
steps: Sysmon Event ID 1 (ProcessCreate) is parsed and included in wt-evtx processes output
Sysmon Event ID 3 (NetworkConnect) is parsed and included in wt-evtx timeline output with src/dst IP and port
Sysmon Event ID 11 (FileCreate) is parsed and appears in timeline with TargetFilename
Sysmon Event ID 13 (RegistryValue set) is parsed and appears in timeline with key path and value
Sysmon events show channel 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' in output
When no Sysmon events exist in the EVTX directory the tool completes without error
